working: Sponges (phylum Porifera) are lower invertebrates with no specialised respiratory structures. Water flowing through the canal system carries dissolved O2, which diffuses into body cells, while CO2 diffuses out. Gas exchange therefore happens by simple diffusion over the entire body surface. Moist cuticle is used by earthworms, tracheal tubes by insects, and gills by aquatic arthropods, molluscs and fishes.
